description_en: Queries the cross-region data backup files of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询某RDS实例跨地域数据备份文件列表
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-cross-region-backups --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCrossRegionBackups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination region for cross-region backup
parameters.name: cross_backup_region

parameters.help_en:
The cross-region backup file ID.
You must specify either CrossBackupId or the time range parameters (StartTime and EndTime)
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域备份文件ID。
CrossBackupId和起止时间参数（StartTime、EndTime）必须传入其中一组
parameters.name: cross_backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

For non-UTC+0 time zones, subtract 8 hours from the actual time before passing the value
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（GMT时间）。

非0时区需要在传入时在实际时间上减去8小时
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

For non-UTC+0 time zones, subtract 8 hours from the actual time before passing the value
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（GMT时间）。

非0时区需要在传入时在实际时间上减去8小时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：

30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query

BackupEndTime.description_en: The time when the backup was generated on the RDS side

BackupMethod.description_en:
The cross-region backup method. Valid values:
L: logical backup
P: physical backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
跨地域备份方式，返回值：
L：逻辑备份
P：物理备份

BackupSetScale.description_en:
The backup policy of the backup file. Valid values:
0: instance backup
1: single-database backup
BackupSetScale.description_zh:
备份文件的备份策略，返回值：
0：实例备份
1：单库备份

BackupSetStatus.description_en:
The status of the dumped backup file. Valid values:
0: backup completed
1: backup failed
BackupSetStatus.description_zh:
转储完成的备份文件状态，返回值：
0：完成备份
1：备份失败

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of the cross-region backup

BackupType.description_en:
The cross-region backup type. Valid values:
F: full backup
I: incremental backup
BackupType.description_zh:
跨地域备份类型，返回值：
F：全量备份
I：增量备份

Category.description_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:

Basic: Basic Edition
HighAvailability: High-availability Edition
Finance: MySQL RDS Enterprise Edition (available only on Chinese site)
Category.description_zh:
实例系列，返回值：

Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列
Finance：MySQL三节点企业系列（仅中国站支持）

ConsistentTime.description_en: The point in time of the data in the backup file
ConsistentTime.description_zh: 备份文件里数据的时间点

CrossBackupDownloadLink.description_en: The public download URL of the cross-region backup file
CrossBackupDownloadLink.description_zh: 跨地域备份文件外网下载链接

CrossBackupRegion.description_en: The ID of the destination region for cross-region backup
CrossBackupRegion.description_zh: 跨地域备份的目的地域ID

CrossBackupSetFile.description_en: The name of the compressed cross-region backup file
CrossBackupSetFile.description_zh: 跨地域备份文件压缩包名称

CrossBackupSetLocation.description_en: The storage location of the backup file

CrossBackupSetSize.description_en: The size of the cross-region backup file. Unit: bytes
CrossBackupSetSize.description_zh: 跨地域备份文件大小，单位：Byte

DBInstanceStorageType.description_en:
The storage type. Valid values:

local_ssd: Premium Local SSDs
cloud_ssd: standard SSDs
cloud_essd: Enterprise SSDs (ESSDs)
DBInstanceStorageType.description_zh:
存储类型，返回值：

local_ssd：高性能本地盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID. This parameter is used to identify whether the backup set was generated on the primary instance or the secondary instance
InstanceId.description_zh: 实例编号。用于区分该备份集产生于主实例或备实例

RestoreRegion.description_en: The list of regions to which the backup file can be restored
RestoreRegion.description_zh: 备份文件可以进行恢复的地域列表，即备份文件可以恢复到哪些地域

items.description_en: The list of regions to which the backup file can be restored
items.description_zh: 备份文件可以进行恢复的地域列表，即备份文件可以恢复到哪些地域

PageNumber.description_en:
The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type.

Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of backup files on the current page

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query
